cover_headline: Tanvi Patri, 15, First Indian Woman to Reach Youth Olympic Badminton Final
facts: Fifteen-year-old Tanvi Patri beat Japan's second seed Yuzuno Watanabe 21-14, 11-21, 21-19 in a 54-minute semifinal
The win guarantees India its first-ever women's singles badminton medal at the Youth Olympic Games — at least a silver is now assured
Patri now faces China's Yi Xin Zhang, the reigning World Junior champion, in the gold-medal match

end.headline: Tanvi Patri, 15, First Indian Woman to Reach Youth Olympic Badminton Final
end.line: The Odisha shuttler beat Japan's second seed Yuzuno Watanabe 21-14, 11-21, 21-19 in 54 minutes, assuring India its first women's singles medal at the Youth Olympic Games.
